stepik_attachment_upload.fail_closed_note: If the API stops exposing POST/multipart file upload, returns a plan/permission blocker, or read-back/download cannot be proven, stop and reopen asset-publication-resolution.

.md.note: Canonical Markdown source remains learner content and must be adapted into the owning Stepik learner step by the verified rendering layer. Nested Markdown dependencies are separate graph nodes and must be resolved by the same policy. This policy does not prescribe blind string replacement.

.png.note: Image must be materialized through the verified Stepik image route during the future write transaction and included in read-back/history evidence.

.svg.note: SVG is a canonical visual source. Rendering layer must deterministically rasterize it to PNG, then materialize it through the verified Stepik image route.
